howToMark: person and owner items: set status to done (with by, on and evidence or a note) or not-applicable with a reason; only the owner marks owner items. Automatic items are recomputed on every review run.

items.question: The round's reference sample is frozen and its lock matches (who interpreted it is recorded in the lock).
items.by: agent-led interpretation (Claude), not a survey or human approval

items.question: The 90% held-out gate passed, or the owner recorded an exception pinning this benchmark in trees.json.
Every felling-screened crown has a verdict in felling-review.json.
The owner confirmed the trees decided felled or not a tree since the laser (removals and not placed).
Every pole-like crown (holds.poleLike) has a verdict in pole-review.json, or the hold is switched off and recorded as such.
Every crown held on a mapped building or with no presence vegetation has a verdict in hold-review.json (bank, present, absent, not-tree or unclear).
The broadleaf calls near play were checked on the leaf-off and presence photos (type-panels chips); tally of verdicts recorded in the note.
items.by: agent-led review (Claude, main session), not the owner
items.evidence: chips of every broadleaf call (June 2024 colour, May 2020 colour infrared; cache only); typeRule.note in course-workflows/norrfallsviken/trees.json
items.note: All 22 broadleaf calls of the first candidates run were checked, the 2 near play among them: about 10 broadleaves (birch and bushes, bare in May 2020 and green in June 2024), 6 small pines in deep shadow, 2 roofs of unmapped houses, 4 unclear; both near-play calls were wrong (a pine at the 9th's edge, a roof behind the 1st green). The type rule now also needs a crown in leaf in June 2024 (broadleafMinimumPresenceShare 0.15), which drops every pine and one roof; the second roof is removed by a spot-check verdict and the other by the hold review. 10 broadleaf calls remain, all in the woodland: 9 of the checked broadleaves and 1 unclear. Near play: no broadleaf call.

items.question: No hole is flagged for a high broadleaf share near play (species-mix.json), or the owner accepted each flag.
The owner compared before/after screenshots of the app on the GPU (holes near play) and the species mix reads right.
Frame times before/after were measured on the owner's GPU (interleaved runs, high and low quality) and accepted.
